title: Free pattern is a plus
text: I wasn't overly impressed with my first shipment.  I was hoping to curb my shopping at on-line quilt shops, but I won't be giving them up soon.  The selvages of the fabric, which would usually contain information about the manufacturer or designer don't, so no credit to the manufacturer or designer.  I'll give the subscription one more month. If there is nothing more notable than was contained in this box, I'll cancel my subscription.  Not impressed.
label: neutral
